defaultSameId: Same View/model/lifetime; To again, no Away; parameter changes do not infer re-entry
entryMode: Explicit NavigationEntryMode.ReenterIfActive; evaluated at owned execution time
apiCompatibility: One new enum, two higher-arity overloads; old signatures/default policy literals unambiguous
ordering: Preflight whole group; hide all; end activation/cleanup then Away once per logical old model; restore/show cached target; fresh activation before To
queuedSupersession: No reset/cleanup/entry before turn; cancelled at head by existing engine
executingExitSupersession: Drain exit; do not restore old activation or create obsolete fresh activation
executingEntrySupersession: Invalidate captured new handle; drain callback and cleanup; later winner unaffected
visibilityLimitation: Existing show-before-To retained; already shown work cannot be retroactively undone
multiRegion: Complete active shared-model cohorts only; cached requested models must be reference-equal; reject partial/heterogeneous/multi-view targets before reset
ownershipTracking: Model-local weak Region bindings; validate actual active IDs/dataSource, not mutable Parent lookup
failures: No rollback/new result API; cleanup/exit failure remains hidden; entry failure keeps Phase2 partial-state contract; successor barriers release safely
reentrancy: Scoped handle required in lifecycle; explicit flag does not bypass held-Region/cycle guards
